Dehydrated Basil Seeds for Wholesale and Export

Basil seeds, also called sabja seeds, tukmaria or sweet basil seeds, are small black seeds that swell in liquid and form a soft, gel-like coat within minutes. Beverage brands, dessert makers, importers, distributors and private label businesses buy them for drinks, falooda, puddings and retail packs. Tradenest Naturals supplies dehydrated basil seeds from India with a clear basil seeds price per kg for trial and bulk orders. We serve domestic and international buyers with bulk dehydrated basil seeds. Our supply covers wholesale sabja seeds orders, custom packing, private label work and export documentation support. Before we confirm an offer, our team reviews your target specification, pack size, destination market and expected annual volume. For a current quotation, share your quantity, destination country, packaging preference and product application. We will reply with pricing, availability, the product specification sheet and a practical dispatch plan.

Product Overview

The seeds are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers who cultivate basil for edible seed. We clean the seeds to remove field dust, stalks and other handling impurities. Controlled drying and sieving then give stable moisture, an even appearance and good packing performance. The seeds stay dry and free-flowing in storage. Once soaked in water, they expand and develop a soft mucilaginous outer layer. That texture is what makes them popular in cold drinks and traditional desserts. Their mild, neutral taste pairs easily with fruit, spice, dairy and botanical flavours. Tradenest Naturals supplies basil seeds as a food ingredient. Buyers should check local regulatory requirements before using them in a finished product. We are happy to review specific needs for beverage, retail and foodservice programmes.

Manufacturing and Processing Method

Every lot starts with raw material inspection and selection. The seeds then go through mechanical cleaning. Where needed, they are dried or conditioned to bring moisture into the agreed range. Finally, we sieve, inspect and pack the seeds in food-grade packaging.
  • Raw seed inspection and supplier selection
  • Mechanical cleaning and foreign-material removal
  • Controlled dehydration or moisture conditioning
  • Sieving to the agreed 16-30 mesh seed-size range
  • Visual inspection and batch identification
  • Food-grade packing with traceability information
The standard product contains no added colours, flavours or preservatives. We recommend confirming the agreed specification before placing a production order. For larger programmes, we can review custom screening, packing, labelling and documentation.

Typical Technical Specifications

Our standard specification suits general food and beverage use. Natural products can vary a little with crop and season. We confirm the final specification through the quotation and sample process.
  • Mesh size: 16-30 mesh whole seeds; custom screening available
  • Moisture content: ≤ 8%
  • Shelf life: 12 months
  • Appearance: clean, black to dark brown whole basil seeds
  • Foreign matter: controlled to the agreed product specification
  • Additives: none in the standard product
  • Flavour: mild, neutral and typical of basil seed
A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Export shipments include a packing list, commercial invoice, country-of-origin details and other agreed export records. We only provide documents that apply to the confirmed order.

Quality Standards and Certifications

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI licensed food business and an IEC registered exporter. We follow documented food-safety practices, batch traceability, raw material inspection, moisture control and in-house quality checks. Each batch is identified so it can be traced through purchasing and receiving. We do not claim certifications we have not confirmed for the product and shipment. If your market needs particular documents, labelling, allergen declarations or tests, please tell us at the quotation stage. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. For every export enquiry, we review the required product standard first. This helps avoid specification gaps and supports smoother customs and receiving. It also shows us whether you need standard food-grade material, a private label pack or a customer-specific quality plan.

Applications

Basil seeds hydrate in liquid and add texture and visual interest to a product. They work well wherever a distinctive seed inclusion is wanted. Common uses include:
  • Traditional basil seed drinks and flavoured beverages
  • Fruit drinks, mocktails, sherbets and refreshment mixes
  • Falooda, puddings, desserts and sweet dishes
  • Herbal and botanical beverage formulations
  • Seed blends, breakfast toppings and snack concepts
  • Bakery, dessert and foodservice applications
  • Retail consumer packs and private label products
Before launch, product developers should test soaking time, inclusion rate, texture and consumer response. The right use level depends on the recipe and the mouthfeel you want. We can share general product information for formulation work, while the buyer validates the finished product.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Basil seeds are packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. The packaging protects against humidity, contamination, light and physical damage in transit. Wholesale and export formats are standard. We can also review custom printed packaging and OEM and private label requirements. Shelf life is 12 months from the manufacturing date when the seeds are sealed and stored correctly. Each approved pack can show the batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions and other agreed label details.

Available Packaging Options

  • 1 kg food-grade pouches
  • 5 kg and 10 kg wholesale bags
  • 25 kg export bags or cartons
  • Bulk bags for larger industrial orders
  • Stand-up pouches for retail and private label programmes
  • PET jars or HDPE containers for consumer and foodservice packs
  • Custom printed and export packaging

Buyer Value

We focus on consistent quality, sensible order sizes and responsive export support. Buyers get one supplier who also understands custom packing and food formulation needs.
  • Dry, stable format for easy storage and handling
  • A 12 month shelf life that reduces the need for frequent restocking
  • Whole seeds give visible texture and help products stand out
  • Flexible packaging for wholesale, retail and private label channels
  • Bulk purchasing helps keep ingredient costs under control
  • Batch traceability supports purchasing and quality records

MOQ, Lead Time, and Sample Requests

The MOQ for dehydrated basil seeds is 5 Kg. This allows trial orders and small first shipments before regular bulk supply. Private label and printed packaging orders are quoted separately, depending on pack format and artwork. Lead time depends on stock, quantity, packaging and export documentation. Custom packing and printed materials can add to the schedule. We confirm the production and dispatch timeline with each quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your target quantity, pack size, destination port, application and required specification. Please include any labelling or documentation requirements. Our team will reply with availability, indicative pricing, sample options and next steps.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What is the minimum order quantity for basil seeds?

The MOQ is 5 Kg. Larger volumes and custom packing are quoted on request. Contact us to discuss the right option for you.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

We are an FSSAI licensed food business and follow documented food-safety practices, raw material inspection, moisture control and batch traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the packaging and shelf-life options?

We offer pouches, bags, PET jars, HDPE containers, bulk bags, export packs and private label formats. Shelf life is 12 months in sealed, cool, dry storage.

What are the typical specifications?

The standard product is dehydrated whole seeds at 16-30 mesh with moisture of 8% or less. Final values are confirmed in the approved commercial specification.

What is the lead time, and how do I request a sample or quote?

Lead time depends on order size and packaging, and we confirm it with each quotation. Send your quantity, destination, packaging needs and application to request a sample or quote.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals brings together ingredient sourcing, drying, packing, export coordination and private label support. We work with importers, distributors, food brands, restaurants, beverage companies and manufacturers. Clear specifications and dependable communication are at the centre of how we work. Whether you need wholesale dehydrated basil seeds for a beverage line or a retail-ready pack, we can help with the next step. Request a quote for current pricing, sample availability and a supply plan that fits your business.
